verdict.rationale: Modern Angular claims fine-grained reactivity via Signals, AOT/tree-shaking, and enterprise-scale usage (angular-docs-1, angular-docs-6), and a Google engineer reports 100k+ SLOC apps scale fine with the style guide (angular-comm-11). However, much of the community evidence describes older AngularJS-era scalability pain (digest-cycle dirty checking, performance cliffs at scale) and organizational/tooling complaints, suggesting the story is only partially and unevenly substantiated across versions.
